messages:
zoe: noticing an uptick in TLS handshake failures between us-west and eu-west services after yesterday's RBAC change. error: "tls: handshake failure (client auth)" reported in ingress-proxy logs. anyone seen this?

derek: seen similar in canary. logs show 401 from cert-connector when requesting peer certs. sample: `2026-03-18T11:22:10Z cert-connector error: GET /v1/keys/peer-ca: permission denied`

maria: that sounds like the cert-connector service account lost iam:Decrypt on the regional KMS key when we tightened RBAC. did we remove the kms-access role from the cross-region-binder?

leo: ops-bot posted the RBAC changelist: https://internal.redwood/review/12345 - it scoped kms roles to project tags, we might have excluded eu-west inadvertently.

ops-bot: automated alert: 3 services failing mTLS handshake in eu-west → us-west, rate 2.1/min. Incident template: /playbooks/peer-identity-failover.md :eyes:

zoe: ok action list proposal: 1) re-grant kms:Decrypt for cert-connector SA in eu-west 2) rotate short-lived certs if keys were re-encrypted 3) audit log search for issuance events during the time window. anyone object?

derek: +1. Quick mitigation: allow fallback to previous CA bundle for 15m while we fix RBAC to avoid user-facing errors. we have fallback mechanism in proxy config: `peer_ca_bundle: [current, previous]`

maria: on audit logging: need to ensure KMS Decrypt calls are logged and forwarded to security-logs for 90d retention. Right now decrypts are only in cloud-provider logs for 30d. I'll open a ticket to extend retention and add an alert on KMS Decrypt failures.

leo: perms PR ready, but want a sanity check on grant scope. granting `roles/kms.cryptoKeyDecrypter` to service-account@cert-connector on keyring `regional/peer-ca` in eu-west. Any objections to that exact role?

zoe: use the minimum scope: cryptoKeyVersions.useToDecrypt if provider supports it. Prefer role with least privilege. Also add condition on resource.name startsWith `projects/redwood/locations/eu-west/keyRings/peer-ca/cryptoKeys/peer-ca-`

maria: agree. Also add an RBAC audit entry in the changelog channel when change is applied. I will also add a short eval to verify mTLS handshakes succeed with both long and short sequences (1k/4k tokens)

ops-bot: deploy-bot: RBAC change queued: PR #6789. CI checks: iam-policy-lint ✅, cross-region-binding-check ❌ (failed due to missing eu-west tag).

derek: quick workaround command to re-add grant using gcloud (run by infra-admin):

```
gcloud kms keys add-iam-policy-binding peer-ca --location=eu-west --keyring=regional \
  --member=serviceAccount:cert-connector@redwood.iam.gserviceaccount.com \
  --role=roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyDecrypter
```
Run as: infra-admin. After that, restart cert-connector pods `kubectl rollout restart deploy/cert-connector -n infra`

zoe: after restart, please verify `openssl s_client -connect ingress-proxy.eu-west.internal:8443 -cert <test-client.pem> -key <test-client-key.pem>` and check `Verify return code: 0 (ok)` and audit log for `Decrypt` entries at the same timestamp.

maria: one more note: we discovered a low-severity libssl CVE (CVE-2026-XXXX) in legacy proxy container that affects session resumption. Not directly related, but we should patch in the same maintenance window if we're touching proxies. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime.

leo: timeline estimate: apply IAM fix in 10m, restart cert-connector in 15-20m, verify handshakes by +30m. If verification fails, switch proxy to fallback CA for 15m and escalate.

zoe: assigning owners: leo -> IAM change + PR; derek -> proxy fallback toggles + verification scripts; maria -> audit log retention ticket + coord with runtime on CVE patch.

maria: I'll also add a short log query for postmortem: `resource.type=\"k8s_container\" AND jsonPayload.message: \"Decrypt\" AND timestamp>=\"2026-03-18T11:00:00Z\"`

derek: test results: after IAM patch and restart, canary shows `Verify return code: 0 (ok)`. Two services still had sporadic failures, flipped fallback CA for 12m and they recovered.

zoe: excellent. follow-ups: 1) expand KMS Decrypt retention to 90d (maria) 2) update RBAC change checklist to include cross-region tag verification (leo) 3) schedule proxy CVE patch in next maintenance (maria + eng-runtime) 4) small runbook update to add next-of-fallback CA time limit (derek).

leo: PR merged. leaving a note in changelog: "IAM fix for cert-connector in eu-west to restore mTLS—2026-03-18" :white_check_mark:

ops-bot: incident resolved: peer-identity failover (eu-west→us-west) — mitigation applied, monitoring green for 45m.

zoe: thanks all :thumbsup: we'll document in postmortem and close the loop on audit retention and CVE patching.
